law: a family under the cut contract holds every BLOCKING arm of scripts/check/family-cut and never grows a pinned counter. A pinned counter is only ever the gate's own measurement: re-pins are taken from the gate's output, never hand-computed
policy: decrease-only: a pinned counter may shrink -- and must then be lowered here -- but may never grow. The one sanctioned exception is an INSTRUMENT-COVERAGE move: when the gate itself starts measuring a corpus it did not scan before, the affected rows are re-pinned to what the gate then measures, the growth is recorded in each row's cutNote as newly visible debt, and no ceiling is raised for source that changed.
roster: a family enters this file when its cut work order opens and leaves the debt columns at 0 when the cut closes; `cut` names the owning work order
